sourceIntent: HBQ rearClear screens the requested rear distance; CBE queue coordination adds a selected explicit travel/clearance demand. Screening a shorter fallback cannot prove that demand.
finding: DrivingRearPlan allowed explicit minimum8m-clearance/6m-travel requests to use ordinary3.5m/2m fallback. Queue VERIFY/COMMIT checked successful observation and target but not returned envelope equality.
implementation: No explicit queue envelope may use ordinary short fallback.
Queue VERIFY/COMMIT compare the returned envelope with the original leaf requirement.
Ordinary recovery fallback and all geometry/authority/execution rechecks remain unchanged. No extra world query or controller.
limits: Admission correction only; actual native reverse direction/travel and cross-owner queue coordination require physical evidence.
Audits remain paused. HBQ whole-source parity and performance are not established.
